name: Two-Weapon Fighting
desc: When a creature takes the Attack action and attacks with a light melee weapon held in one hand, it can use a bonus action to attack with a different light melee weapon held in the other hand. The bonus-action attack does not add the creature's ability modifier to its damage unless that modifier is negative. If either weapon has the thrown property, it can be hurled instead of made as a melee attack.
